title: Agent Contract front matter (format draft 0.1)
description: YAML front matter of a <name>.contract.md file, as accepted by APMX 0.8.0. Draft; not stable. The Markdown body (the role) is not covered by this schema and must be non-empty.

needs.description: Inputs: caller-supplied files (the assignment) or handoffs produced by another contract in the factory. May be omitted or empty.

produces.description: Deliverables: files the contract must deliver. Paths must not collide or overlap.

imports.description: Dependencies: names of skills declared in the package's dependency manifest. Names only; versions are pinned by the package lock.

items.description: A skill name, not a storage path or version: no '.' or '..' segments, no apm_modules/ prefix.

budget.description: Budget: attempts and wall-clock seconds shared by all attempts and checks. Without a budget, one attempt.

verify.description: Checks: check name to command. Exit 0 passes, exit 1 rejects, any other exit is an operational failure.

path.description: A fixed relative file path: no globs, no absolute path, no '.' or '..' segments, no leading or trailing whitespace, and no .git, .apm or apm_modules segment (case-insensitive; not fully expressible here).
